# KodeToCareer — AI-Powered Software Training Institute

> Premier AI-powered software training institute specializing in Full Stack Web Development, Data Science, AI Engineering, and Cloud DevOps with 100% placement support.

## Core Information
- **Website**: https://kodetocareer.com
- **Founder & Lead Instructor**: Md Arbaaz
- **Location**: A-48 Basement, Sector 2, Near Sector 15 Metro Station, Noida, UP 201301, India
- **Accreditation**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- **Placement Support**: 100% placement assistance, 300+ hiring partners, 1,200+ trained students, 95% placement rate, salary range ₹6.5 LPA - ₹14 LPA.

## Flagship Training Programs
- **MERN Stack Development**: Full stack React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Next.js, and AI API integration. [Course Link](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mern-stack-development)
- **Data Science & Machine Learning**: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, Computer Vision, and Predictive Analytics. [Course Link](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning)
- **Java Full Stack Developer**: Enterprise Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, PostgreSQL, Docker, and React. [Course Link](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/java-full-stack)
- **Cloud DevOps**: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines. [Course Link](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/cloud-devops)
- **Data Analytics**: SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and Business Intelligence. [Course Link](https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-analytics)
